# Vendored map libraries

Pinned upstream distribution files, copied unchanged from the npm release archives. No CDN or package-manager execution is required at runtime. Download integrity was checked against each npm release metadata SHA-512 integrity value; SHA-256 values below and in `manifest.json` permit offline verification.

Leaflet 1.9.4: BSD-2-Clause (`leaflet-1.9.4/LICENSE`).
Leaflet.markercluster 1.5.3: MIT (`leaflet.markercluster-1.5.3/MIT-LICENCE.txt`).

OpenStreetMap tiles are **not** vendored. They are disabled by default; opting in for the current tab sends the viewed area and IP address to OpenStreetMap. Local scripts/CSS are served even offline.
